actions.why: A stepped lane from the Mese straight up the middle of the hill, so a carrier no longer threads between houses with a full jar.

The water-carriers' first cistern (AF 54) sits at the foot of the hill and the queue there runs till dark; the families of the upper slope pool their coppers again for a second cistern at the head of the new steps.

rejected.reason: no road within 25 units; nobody could reach it
rejected.fix: the Carriers' Steps are listed first, so the lane exists when the cistern is judged
